b1_scouts_ahead.speaker: finch_pilot
lines: Finch, Wren and Kite running ahead.
If the rocks move, I'll yell.

b1_contact_glyphs.speaker: finch_pilot
lines: It's pulsing at us in groups of five.
Logging everything.

b1_finch_hit.speaker: finch_pilot
lines: Finch is hit! I'm losing systems!

b1_seed_shield.speaker: engineer
lines: Our shots are splashing off. It has a shield!
Keep hitting the same side.

b1_seed_closing.speaker: captain
lines: It's closing on Kestrel. Teo, keep our guns on it!

b1_weapons_gone.speaker: wren_pilot
lines: Wren's guns are slag. Kite's too.
We've got engines. That's all we've got.

b1_hurl_wren.speaker: wren_pilot
lines: Wren, taking the bow.
Don't watch this one, Captain.

b1_hurl_kite.speaker: kite_pilot
lines: Kite has the stern.
Been a privilege, Kestrel.

b2_mines_set.speaker: engineer
lines: Charges are cold and quiet.
Please don't fly into our own.

b2_choke.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines: They're in the choke. Nowhere to turn.

b2_mine_boom.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines: Boom! Map that!

b2_dead_in_water.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines: Its engines are cooked! It's just drifting!
Dead in the water. Line it up.

b2_second_seed.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines: Second contact, right behind the first.
It still hasn't seen the charges.

b3_cover.speaker: captain
lines: Stay behind the rocks. Make it come to us.

b3_pd_stopped.speaker: engineer
lines: Missile swatted. Their point defence is fast.

b3_hull_low.speaker: engineer
lines: The hull's paper-thin. One more hit and we're breathing vacuum.

b3_flank_open.speaker: li
lines: Their back's wide open. Hitting it now!

b4_too_easy.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines: Is it just me, or are these things barely fighting?
Easiest job ever.

b4_graft_hint.speaker: engineer
lines: I'm reading a strange power source in hangar four.
Ooh. Shiny.

b4_seam_hums.speaker: tern_pilot
lines: The seam's humming again.
Kind of soothing, actually.

b5_jammed.speaker: tern_pilot
lines: Comms are jammed! Line of sight only!

b5_kestrel_unresponsive.speaker: engineer
lines: Kestrel isn't answering the helm!
Something is overriding us!

b5_li_coming.speaker: li
lines: Hold on, Vey. I'm coming.
